lines.text: Do you know how disappearing messages work? They don't vanish from the internet by magic.
When you send one, it still travels through the app's servers, and lands on your friend's phone like any other message.
But the app attaches a timer. When it runs out, the app on each phone deletes the message.
And the company's servers are set to delete their copy too, once it's been delivered or has expired.
There's a catch. Some apps block screenshots, but nothing can stop someone pointing another camera at the screen.
Orbi files disappear too. By default, 30 minutes after you send, the locked pieces on the server are deleted. You can choose anything from five to 30 minutes.
